Potentiam is a fast-growing global offshore solutions provider connecting top talent with leading UK and European businesses. With offices across South Africa, Romania, India, and Brazil, we offer international exposure, real career progression, and the opportunity to work with high-performing global teams.
 We combine global opportunity with local support giving you the chance to grow, make an impact, and build a long-term career in a business that’s scaling fast.
 Global clients. Clear progression. Real opportunity. 
 We are an equal opportunity employer. We encourage applications from people with disabilities and will provide reasonable accommodation during the hiring process.
 We’re looking for a Junior Reporting Analyst (Qlik Cloud/Power BI) to join our client’s Data & AI team. 
 In this role, you will work closely with customers and colleagues to understand business requirements and support the development of clear, reliable and impactful dashboards, reports and analytical solutions using Qlik Cloud and/or Microsoft Power BI.
 What you’ll do: 
Assist in designing, developing and maintaining dashboards and reports using Qlik Cloud, Qlik Sense and Power BI.
Support the development and optimization of data models, measures and business logic.
Work with Qlik scripting, Set Analysis, DAX and Power Query to build and improve reporting solutions.
Extract, analyze and validate data from multiple sources using SQL.
Work with business users to understand reporting requirements and translate them into effective visualizations.
Perform testing, troubleshooting and data validation to ensure reporting accuracy and quality.
Help maintain and improve existing dashboards, reports and analytical solutions.
Support customers and internal teams with BI solution deployment, administration and ongoing maintenance.
Collaborate with consultants, data engineers and solution architects on reporting and BI projects.
Continuously develop technical knowledge and expertise across both Qlik and Power BI platforms.
 What we’re looking for: 
Basic knowledge or initial experience with Qlik Sense/Qlik Cloud and/or Microsoft Power BI.
Understanding of data modelling concepts and data visualization principles.
Basic to intermediate SQL skills, including querying, joins and data validation.
Familiarity with DAX, Power Query, Qlik scripting or Set Analysis is an advantage.
Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into reporting solutions.
Strong analytical, problem-solving and attention-to-detail skills.
Good communication and collaboration skills.
Proactive attitude and willingness to learn new technologies.
Interest in developing expertise across both Qlik and Power BI.
 Data Privacy Notice: 
 The personal information you provide during the application and recruitment process will be used solely for recruitment purposes, in accordance with our data protection policies.
 For any questions regarding data processing related to HR activities, please contact Chantal Endemann at careers@potentiam.co.uk.
 All data shared with third parties complies with applicable confidentiality and retention requirements.
